name: squoosh
description_en: Make images smaller using best-in-class codecs, right in the browser.
readme_excerpt: [Squoosh]! [Squoosh] is an image compression web app that reduces image sizes through numerous formats. Privacy Squoosh does not send your image to a server. All image compression processes locally. However, Squoosh utilizes Google Analytics to collect the following: - Basic visitor data. - The before and after image size value. - If Squoosh PWA, the type of Squoosh installation. - If Squoosh PWA, the installation time and date.
